panels.title: 🎃 Welcome to Steal an RNG — play fair, roll HUGE!
panels.description:
**1.** Be kind. No harassment, hate speech, slurs, threats, or targeted bullying.

**2.** Keep everything safe for the community: no explicit content, gore, doxxing, or sharing private details.

**3.** No scams, fake giveaways, account sales, or off-platform item sales. Trade at your own risk; staff never ask for passwords.

**4.** No exploits, cheating instructions, exploit links, or bypass guides. Report vulnerabilities privately in a ticket.

**5.** No spam, excessive mentions, disruptive audio, or unsolicited advertising and Discord invites.

**6.** Use English in main channels so everyone can join in. Respect all cultures and backgrounds.

**7.** Follow channel topics. Keep trading in trading and support in tickets. Never post private receipts in public.

**8.** Respect staff decisions. Appeal calmly through an Appeal ticket; never impersonate staff or stefunkwn.

**9.** Follow Discord Community Guidelines and Roblox Terms of Use. No real-money or Robux gambling.

**10.** Play fair, have fun, and protect your account. Use official links and report suspicious DMs.

panels.title: ✅ Unlock the community
panels.description: Read #rules, then accept below. Verification means you agree to the rules. This does not link your Roblox account.

panels.title: 🎲 New raider FAQ
panels.description:
**How do I roll?**
Join the game and use its Roll control to collect fighters and abilities. Check the in-game UI for current costs and luck boosts.

**What are the rarities?**
Street → Forged → Awakened → Ascended → Legendary → Mythic → Divine → Celestial → Forbidden → Absolute → OMEGA → Admin-only. Discord ranks measure chat activity, not in-game ownership.

**How does stealing work?**
Raid unlocked bases and try to steal units while fighting defenders. Check the in-game prompts for carrying and escape controls.

**How do I lock my base?**
Use the base lock control. Lock duration and cooldown appear in the game; do not trust offers to bypass protection.

**What is new-player protection?**
New players have protection while learning. Your in-game indicator is the authority on when it ends.

**Why rebirth?**
Rebirths unlock multipliers and perks such as Double Dash, Double Jump, Ground Pound, Blink, and Triple Dash. Read the confirmation screen for what resets.

**How do codes work?**
Open the game’s redeem-code UI, enter an active code exactly, and confirm. /codes lists developer-confirmed codes; none are invented.

**When are events?**
Witching Hour runs hourly in game. Weather and KONG / STEF vs GODZILLA events are announced here when confirmed. Exact timezone and limited-event dates: [DEV TO CONFIRM].

**How do I report a bug?**
Use /bugreport for non-sensitive bugs. Include platform, steps, expected/actual results, and a screenshot link. Exploits and personal information belong in private tickets.
